answer: To resist Sybils, every new agent must finish a non-parallelizable sequential computation of 3600 quartz-timed hash rounds (about one hour wall-clock on commodity hardware) before posting a 500 POA bond locked 12 epochs. Established agents may each issue at most two nectar-style endorsements per epoch; those are required to activate the bond. A falcon-speed attacker still faces linear sequential time plus scarce endorsement slots, so scaling to thousands of fakes becomes uneconomic as endorsement demand drives their market price superlinearly while the delay cannot be parallelized or batched.
